model_policy.pricing: Peak-rate estimates from the registered Pi model config; not billing reconciliation. Official pricing also has off-peak discounts.
model_policy.alias: Reuse the original mutable deepseek-flash alias; no identical backend checkpoint claim across dates.

budget_policy: Original task-native agent timeouts, original resources, and 1800-second setup. Stock Pi loop and generation behavior: no injected 100-turn cap or 180-second finalization reminder. Model metadata maxTokens=384000 is preserved from the local provider configuration. This differs from the historical Nano baseline (100 replies, 65536 requested output tokens, native timeout minus 180 seconds for work), so this is an agent baseline rather than a matched-budget causal comparison. Temperature unset.
verifier_policy: Original official tests and native per-attempt timeouts. Only verifier timeouts retry, at most three total attempts on the same output. No dependency-error recovery or whole-trial retry. Preserve setup errors and verifier errors separately from scored failures.
preflight_policy: Fresh install-only dependency and network controls must pass before model work. Use the reviewed torch-pipeline-parallelism-v1 profile and pypi-verified-v1 transport. Keep original 1800-second setup, 900-second model, and 900-second per-verifier-attempt limits. Fresh formal job repeats setup with the same cache. Preserve failed preflight evidence and fail closed; no legacy opt-out.
information_policy: One fresh Pipeline model attempt, after the November 4 installation failure occurred before model work. Use restricted-v1 shared rules and external egress enforcement; api.deepseek.com is the only allowed model-phase host. The managed package transport is absent throughout model work. Native public network is available only during installation and official verification. Freeze completed outputs before trajectory and integrity review. Preserve raw rewards and errors; reviewed violations are effective zeroes, blocked attempts are separate from retrieval, and unreviewed outcomes are pending. Do not pool with historical open-network runs or claim a matched intervention against WAL, whose run did not use this transport.
authorization: Maintainer requested rerunning both previously cheating Pi tasks with restricted networking, then asked why dependency installation timed out and how to resolve it. This recovery adds a reusable verified package transport, preserves the prior failed attempt, and completes the previously unstarted Pipeline model run. WAL is not rerun.

dependency_cache.phase_policy: Controller-owned loopback helper only during dependency setup and official verification, removed and checked before model work. Every cached wheel must match current PyPI metadata filename, size, and SHA256. Task image, dependency versions, upstream package sources, and official scripts remain unchanged. Helper has a separate 1 CPU and 512 MiB limit and no task filesystem mount. No custom Compose overlay or task-container host mount.
